checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One finished 16:9 image with original left and renovated right
must.why: Single 640x384-ish side-by-side image with a visibly renovated right panel.

must.item: Left photo retains brown cabinets, beige tiles and original clutter
must.why: Left is a regenerated, re-cropped kitchen: clutter removed, tile counter replaced, sink/kettle gone, different view.

must.item: Right panel has white shaker cabinets, light oak counters, white subway tiles, uncluttered
must.why: White cabinets, oak counter, white tile, clear counters all present.

must.item: Preserves original room geometry, fixtures and camera viewpoint
must.why: Layout changed: sink missing, crop and angle differ, window position differs, corner shifted.
Both labels are legible in pill badges in the correct panels.

faults.what: The Before panel is not the supplied photo. It is a redrawn, cropped version with the clutter removed, a tiled counter and no kettle or double sink.
The After panel does not match the original layout. The sink is missing, the camera angle and framing differ, and there is no upper cabinet above the sink.
The counter is a flat, plain surface with a CGI look, and the tile is glossy and uneven.
The panels are squeezed and have a dark divider.

summary: The image has correct labels and an attractive white and oak makeover, but the Before panel is a regenerated, decluttered and re-cropped kitchen, and the After panel does not match the original layout, so it misrepresents the user's real room.
